title: Legal Defense Strategy for Section 148 Income Tax Reassessment Notices
summary: A comprehensive roadmap for replying to reassessment notices under Section 148 and Section 148A of the Income Tax Act.
body:
Receiving a notice under Section 148 indicates that the assessing officer has reason to believe income chargeable to tax has escaped assessment.

For urgent statutory relief, consult our [Section 148 Notice Defense Counsel](/services) or visit our [Baidyabati Head Chambers](/locations/baidyabati-sheoraphuli) directly to review your assessment files.

Submitting forensic financial reconstructions before the statutory cutoff is essential to prevent adverse reassessment orders. You can also [schedule a consultation](/schedule) with our principal advocate for direct representation.
